svg.title: Tail latency
svg.desc: Opening the feed fans out to many services at once. Four answer in about 20 ms, but one like counts replica takes 450 ms, and the whole page waits for it. On the second pass the feed service sends a hedged copy to a second replica after 40 ms, takes whichever answer lands first, and the page is ready in 62 ms.
svg.text: One slow reply holds up the page. A hedged read to a twin answers first.
